### 🔗 Page
The URL, e.g. `https://gridworkz.com/docs/hardware/npu`

### 📝 What's wrong
A broken link, an outdated spec, a typo, a layout problem on your device…

### ✅ What it should say or do
If it's a spec, link the source in grx930, grxgpu or grxcp if you can.

### 💻 Device and browser (for layout problems)
e.g. iPhone 15, Safari
